articleTitle: What to Do After a Blackout You Can't Remember Consenting To
imageHeadline: What a blackout means for consent
imageSubtext: When your brain stopped recording, could you really agree?
pinTitle: What to Do After a Blackout You Can't Remember Consenting To | Mindtivate
pinDescription: A blackout isn't passing out—it's when your brain stops forming memories while you're still awake. If you were vomiting, couldn't stand, and blacked out, you were incapacitated. Here's what that means for consent, what options you have now, and where to get support.

items.label: Understand what happened in your brain
